string.text: If I fall asleep now, I might not wake up.
The radiation is burning me from the inside. If I fall asleep now, I might not wake up.
The bleeding won't stop. If I fall asleep now, I might not wake up.
Hunger has drained all my strength. If I fall asleep now, I might not wake up.
This place is crushing my mind. If I fall asleep now, I might not wake up.
